purpose: Separate raw build measurements from claims of a clean baseline/candidate speedup.
fixed_pair_inputs: same emsdk manager commit and emsdk version
same platform and immutable src/wasm context tree for the side being measured
same host and dedicated builder limits

all_required: Builder remains running/RW and exact resource readback matches the resource_contract for each run.
No active shared-host bulk cleanup/backup or other heavy build overlaps the paired measurement window.
Host load averages (1, 5, 15 minute) are sampled immediately before and after each run; each is <=4.0 on this 8-CPU host.
For each baseline/candidate pair, corresponding load averages differ by <=2.0; otherwise report the pair as noisy/reference only.
Baseline/candidate order alternates across representative PHP versions and repeat blocks; both sides use identical PHP source/tool/base/features/resources.
For repeated cases n>=3, report all samples, median, median absolute deviation, cache hits/misses and completed/rebuilt stages; keep cold separate from warm.
clean_speed_claim_eligibility.policy_effect: These are analytical eligibility criteria, not permission to start or stop builds. Runs may proceed when they fail; such durations remain reference-only and cannot support a clean speed claim.

schedule_order.cold: Pair baseline/candidate per PHP version; baseline first for5.6, candidate first for7.4, baseline first for8.5.
schedule_order.warm: At least one excluded prime then3 measured cached target builds per side/version; alternate which side is run first across PHP versions.
schedule_order.php-version: Before each of3 measured samples, prime the other pinned PHP version; use identical transition/source pair on both sides; alternate side order across versions.
schedule_order.link-input-change: Three distinct comment-only immutable variants, each with unchanged-parent prime; identical patch variant on both sides; alternate baseline/candidate first across variants.

current_run_check.reason: Load averages materially exceed the <=4.0 threshold; retain as contended/reference evidence only.
